questions.question: What does a slow-moving vehicle emblem look like?

options.text: A rectangular red sign.
A circular green sign.
A diamond-shaped yellow sign.
A triangular orange sign.

questions.correctAnswerText: A triangular orange sign.
questions.explanation: The slow-moving vehicle emblem is a reflective orange triangle. Vehicles with this emblem drive at speeds of 25 mph or slower.

questions.question: To pass a slower vehicle on a two-lane road, you must:

options.text: Not cross the centerline.
Flash your lights at oncoming traffic.
Use the shoulder.
Use the lane for oncoming traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Use the lane for oncoming traffic.
questions.explanation: To pass on a two-lane road, you must use the lane for oncoming traffic. Only pass if it is safe and legal to do so.

questions.question: What do regulatory signs do?

options.text: Are placed in every location where there is a present danger.
Tell drivers what they must or must not do.
Are diamond-shaped and yellow or green.
May warn drivers about a school zone.

questions.correctAnswerText: Tell drivers what they must or must not do.
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs are usually rectangular with black markings on white. They tell drivers what they must or must not do. They show speed limits, no passing rules, no turning rules, and other driving regulations.

questions.question: You are waiting in the intersection to turn left. What should you do?

options.text: Signal and turn your wheels to the left.
Signal and keep your wheels straight.
Flash your headlights so drivers will let you through.
Drive around a car that blocks you.

questions.correctAnswerText: Signal and keep your wheels straight.
questions.explanation: Always signal before turning. Keep your wheels straight while waiting to turn left. If another car hits you from behind, straight wheels prevent you from being pushed into oncoming traffic.

questions.question: A solid white line on the right edge of the highway slopes toward the center. This means:

options.text: An intersection is just ahead.
You are approaching a construction area.
You must turn left soon.
The road gets narrower ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road gets narrower ahead.
questions.explanation: A solid line marks the edge of the road between the travel lane and shoulder. When the edge line slopes toward the center, the road is getting narrower ahead.

questions.question: Blood alcohol content (BAC) depends on all of these except:

options.text: Your body weight.
How much you drink.
How much time passes between drinks.
How physically fit you are.

questions.correctAnswerText: How physically fit you are.
questions.explanation: BAC depends on how much you drink, how much time passes between drinks, and your body weight. Physical fitness does not affect BAC.

questions.question: When entering a highway from an entrance ramp, you should:

options.text: Speed up faster than traffic to get ahead.
Enter slowly to avoid other vehicles.
Stop first, then slowly enter traffic.
Speed up to match traffic speed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Speed up to match traffic speed.
questions.explanation: Use the acceleration lane to speed up to match traffic. Signal, look for an opening, and merge safely into traffic.

questions.question: You see a flashing yellow light at an intersection. You should:

options.text: Stop and wait for the light to change.
Make a U-turn because the intersection is closed.
Drive carefully through the intersection.
Get ready to stop; the light is about to turn red.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drive carefully through the intersection.
questions.explanation: A flashing yellow light means proceed slowly and cautiously. Look both ways before entering the intersection.

questions.question: What is a "No zone"?

options.text: A designated no passing zone.
A one-way traffic area.
The blind spot of a large vehicle.
An area for motor vehicles only.

questions.correctAnswerText: The blind spot of a large vehicle.
questions.explanation: "No zones" are the blind spots around trucks and large vehicles. Do not stay in a truck's blind spot.

questions.question: If a driver gets ____ points in 24 months, their license will be suspended.
questions.explanation: If a driver gets 18 or more points within 24 months, their license will be suspended.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for trucks.
Do not pass trucks.
Truck parking area ahead.
Steep hill ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Steep hill ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep hill is coming.

questions.question: A leaking exhaust system can:

options.text: Cause excessive oil use.
Require your vehicle to need a tune-up sooner.
Make you drowsy while driving.
Set grass fires on country roads.

questions.correctAnswerText: Make you drowsy while driving.
questions.explanation: The exhaust system removes toxic gases from the engine. A leak can release dangerous fumes that make you sleepy and impair your driving.

questions.question: If a driver gets ____ points in a 12-month period, their license will be suspended.

options.text: Five

questions.explanation: If you get 12 or more points within 12 months, your license will be suspended.

questions.question: When merging onto a freeway, it is usually best to:

options.text: Go slowly and wait for an opening.
Speed up faster than the traffic around you.
Turn on your hazard lights until you are safely on the freeway.
Speed up to match the freeway traffic speed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Speed up to match the freeway traffic speed.
questions.explanation: Use the on-ramp to speed up to the speed of freeway traffic. This helps you blend in smoothly and safely. You must yield to cars already on the freeway.

questions.question: A broken yellow line next to a solid yellow line means:

options.text: Passing on the left is allowed from either direction.
Passing is allowed from the lane with the broken line.
Passing is allowed from the lane with the solid line.
Passing is not allowed from either direction.

questions.correctAnswerText: Passing is allowed from the lane with the broken line.
questions.explanation: When a broken yellow line is next to a solid yellow line, passing is allowed only from the side with the broken line.

questions.question: If there are two railroad tracks next to each other:

options.text: It is always safe to cross after one train passes.
You must always stop before crossing the tracks.
After one train passes, check for another train on the other track before crossing.
Honk your horn as you cross the tracks.

questions.correctAnswerText: After one train passes, check for another train on the other track before crossing.
questions.explanation: Always check both tracks for approaching trains. Do not cross until you are sure no train is coming from either direction on either track.

questions.question: A speed restriction sign:

options.text: Can be ignored in rain, snow, or ice.
Has a triangular shape.
Is blue with black letters.
Shows a recommended speed for curves and turns.

questions.correctAnswerText: Shows a recommended speed for curves and turns.
questions.explanation: These signs show a recommended speed for driving through curves and turns. You should follow this speed in all weather, especially in rain, snow, or ice.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Bicycle crossing.
Stop.
Fines double in a work zone.
Stop ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Bicycle crossing.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign alerts you to watch for bicycles crossing the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Cars in the right lane must slow down.
No left turn.
Merge.
Pass only in the right lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Merge.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that two lanes moving in the same direction will become one lane.

questions.question: Where should your hands be on the steering wheel?

options.text: 3 and 9 o'clock
1 and 11 o'clock
2 and 10 o'clock
4 and 8 o'clock

questions.correctAnswerText: 3 and 9 o'clock
questions.explanation: Place both hands on the outside of the steering wheel at 3 and 9 o'clock for good control. The 2 and 10 o'clock position is not recommended because it can be unsafe with airbags.

questions.question: You are driving on a highway with two solid yellow lines dividing it. What are you allowed to do?

options.text: Cross these lines only to turn left into or out of an alley, private road, or driveway.
Cross these lines to pass other vehicles if no traffic is coming toward you.
Never cross these lines.
Cross these lines only to make a U-turn.

questions.correctAnswerText: Cross these lines only to turn left into or out of an alley, private road, or driveway.
questions.explanation: Double solid yellow lines mean no passing is allowed in either direction. You may only cross them to turn left into or out of an alley, private road, or driveway.

questions.question: A fully loaded tractor-trailer traveling at 55 mph may need up to ____ feet to stop completely.

options.text: 50 feet
125 feet
400 feet
750 feet

questions.correctAnswerText: 400 feet
questions.explanation: Tractor-trailers need much longer distances to stop than smaller cars at the same speed. A fully loaded tractor-trailer may need almost 400 feet to stop when traveling at 55 mph.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Turn right only after coming to a complete stop.
Right turns are not allowed.
Left turns are allowed.
None of the above.

questions.correctAnswerText: Right turns are not allowed.
questions.explanation: This is a regulatory sign that shows rules drivers must follow. Right turns are not permitted where this sign is posted.

questions.question: When parking uphill next to a curb, set the parking brake and:

options.text: Keep the rear tires touching the curb.
Keep the front tires pointing straight.
Turn your steering wheel away from the curb.
Turn your steering wheel toward the curb.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn your steering wheel away from the curb.
questions.explanation: When parking uphill next to a curb, set the parking brake and turn the steering wheel away from the curb. If your vehicle rolls, it will roll into the curb and stop.

questions.question: Traffic lights sometimes show arrows to control turns from specific lanes. What does a solid red arrow mean?

options.text: It is never used in traffic signals.
It means the same as a red circular traffic light.
It means drivers may turn in the direction the arrow points.
It means traffic in that direction must stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: It means the same as a red circular traffic light.
questions.explanation: A solid red arrow means the same thing as a red circular traffic light. When you see a red arrow, you must stop and cannot turn in the direction the arrow points.
